name: paired box 3
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PAX3 encodes paired box protein Pax-3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Waardenburg syndrome (autosomal dominant); Waardenburg syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Rhabdomyosarcoma; Biphenotypic sinonasal sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
